title: Comparer, classer et décrire une évolution
summary: Choose adjective or adverb comparisons, build superlatives and describe linked or gradual changes.
objectives: Choose meilleur/mieux and appropriate worse forms.
Agree adjectival superlatives and use supérieur/inférieur à.

sources.label: B1 public topic index (coverage reference only)

sections.title: What is better: a thing or a performance?
paragraphs: Bon is an adjective describing a noun; its comparative is meilleur, meilleure, meilleurs, meilleures. Bien is an adverb describing how something is done; its comparative mieux is invariable. Le meilleur gâteau is the best cake; elle cuisine le mieux means she cooks best. The adjective meilleur already contains the comparison: do not add plus.

Mauvais can become plus mauvais or pire. Plus mauvais is a straightforward degree comparison; pire often highlights deterioration or an undesirable situation. Both can be valid, especially in negative evaluations. Mal becomes plus mal for a worse performance or condition; de pire en pire is also a fixed expression of deterioration. Do not use mieux to agree with a feminine noun or use meilleur as an adverb describing parler.
points: Vocabulary: un trajet (masculine), a journey; une connexion (feminine), a connection; un résultat (masculine), a result.
Pire is not the comparative of mal in every possible context: il conduit plus mal is the ordinary action comparison.

examples.english: This connection is better than the old one.
examples.note: An adjective agrees with feminine connexion.

examples.french: Avec ce micro, on vous entend **mieux**.
examples.english: With this microphone, we can hear you better.
examples.note: The adverb describes hearing and stays invariable.

examples.english: The situation is worse than yesterday.
examples.note: A worsening situation naturally takes pire.

examples.french: Sans ses lunettes, il lit **plus mal**.
examples.english: Without his glasses, he reads less well.
examples.note: The comparison concerns how he reads.

mistakes.why: Explique needs an adverb describing the action: mieux.

sections.title: Superlatives and comparisons with à
paragraphs: For adjective ranking within a group, use le/la/les plus or le/la/les moins, with the adjective agreeing normally: la solution la plus simple, les trajets les moins longs. When the adjective normally precedes the noun, the superlative can precede it too: le plus beau jardin. With a possessive, use mon meilleur souvenir, not mon le meilleur souvenir.

Bon's adjectival superlative is le meilleur/la meilleure/les meilleurs/les meilleures. Bien's adverbial superlative is le mieux and stays fixed: elles travaillent le mieux. Pire or plus mauvais can form adjectival worst: la pire solution/la plus mauvaise solution. Plus mal gives le plus mal for an action.

Supérieur and inférieur already express higher/better and lower/lesser relative position. Use à, not que, and do not add plus in the ordinary direct comparison: supérieur à, inférieur à. They still agree: une valeur supérieure, des prix inférieurs. The comparison may concern an amount, ranking or quality; it is not always a judgment of human worth.
points: For a comparison of one thing with itself at different times, the article can behave differently: c'est le matin qu'elle est le plus attentive. The exercises here rank distinct things or people.
De can introduce the comparison group: le plus calme du quartier.

examples.french: C'est la salle **la moins bruyante** du bâtiment.
examples.english: It is the least noisy room in the building.
examples.note: La and bruyante agree with salle.
A possessive takes the place of the definite article.

examples.french: Les frais sont **inférieurs au** budget prévu.
examples.english: The costs are lower than the planned budget.

examples.french: Cette capacité est **supérieure à** celle du modèle précédent.
examples.english: This capacity is higher than that of the previous model.
examples.note: No plus, and the comparison uses à.

mistakes.avoid: Ce prix est plus inférieur que l'autre.
mistakes.prefer: Ce prix est inférieur à l'autre.
mistakes.why: Inférieur already expresses comparison and takes à.

sections.title: Gradual change and linked change
paragraphs: De plus en plus and de moins en moins express gradual increase or decrease: de plus en plus rapide, de moins en moins cher. For improving performance use de mieux en mieux; for improving noun quality use de meilleur en meilleur with agreement where needed, such as de meilleures en meilleures. De pire en pire is a common worsening expression.

Plus..., plus... means the more..., the more...; moins..., moins... means the less..., the less...; mixed patterns are possible. Put a complete clause after each comparative: Plus je pratique, moins j'hésite. Do not translate English the into a French article. For quantity within these clauses use plus de/moins de plus a noun.
points: Choose mieux for improving how an action is done, meilleur for improving quality of a noun.
The paired clauses express a relationship, not necessarily proven scientific causation.

examples.french: Elle comprend **de mieux en mieux** les annonces.
examples.english: She understands the announcements better and better.

examples.french: Le bruit devient **de pire en pire**.
examples.english: The noise is getting worse and worse.

examples.french: **Plus** nous préparons la visite, **moins** nous sommes stressés.
examples.english: The more we prepare the visit, the less stressed we are.
examples.note: Two complete clauses show linked change.

examples.french: **Moins** il y a de voitures, **plus** le quartier est calme.
examples.english: The fewer cars there are, the quieter the neighbourhood is.

sections.title: Évaluer une qualité, une situation ou une nouvelle
paragraphs: Do not turn the adjective/adverb distinction into a ban on mieux after être. Une meilleure organisation evaluates a noun's quality; c'est mieux can judge an arrangement or a course of action as preferable overall. Start by restoring the positive expression: a judgment based on bon leads to meilleur, whereas one based on bien leads to mieux. Mieux does not acquire agreement even when the speaker or the people affected are feminine or plural.

A comparison describes a difference; a short reaction evaluates news. Tant mieux welcomes a development, while tant pis accepts or regrets an unwelcome one. Tant pis can sound dismissive if someone else has suffered a serious problem: tone and context matter. De mal en pis is a fixed expression for deterioration, often more marked or literary than de pire en pire; pis is not a productive replacement for every ordinary plus mal.
points: For an intended action, ask whether you are naming a better thing or judging what would work better. Neither English better nor the verb être alone settles the choice.

examples.french: Pour garder une trace, **c'est mieux** de répondre par écrit.
examples.english: To keep a record, it is better to reply in writing.
examples.note: This evaluates a course of action, not the grammatical gender of a noun.
Protection is a feminine noun whose quality is compared.

examples.french: Le colis est arrivé intact. **Tant mieux** !
examples.english: The parcel arrived intact. That's good news!
examples.note: A favourable reaction, not a statement that something is best in a group.

examples.french: Le café est fermé. **Tant pis**, nous irons ailleurs.
examples.english: The café is closed. Oh well, we'll go elsewhere.
examples.note: A resigned response to a minor inconvenience.

examples.french: Malgré les réparations, les choses vont **de mal en pis**.
examples.english: Despite the repairs, things are going from bad to worse.
examples.note: A fixed expression; keep pis here rather than generalizing it to every worse comparison.

mistakes.avoid: Pour éviter la file, c'est meilleure de réserver.
mistakes.prefer: Pour éviter la file, c'est mieux de réserver.
mistakes.why: The sentence evaluates booking as a course of action. There is no feminine noun for meilleure to qualify.

practice.prompt: Supply meilleur in the correct form: Cette méthode est ___ que l'autre.
practice.explanation: Méthode is feminine singular.

practice.prompt: Supply the comparative of bien: Depuis les cours, il écrit ___.
practice.explanation: Writing better needs the adverb mieux.

practice.prompt: Supply the preposition: un montant supérieur ___ cent euros.
practice.explanation: Supérieur takes à.

practice.prompt: Complete the fixed phrase meaning worse and worse: de ___ en ___. Give both words separated by a comma.
practice.explanation: De pire en pire expresses deterioration.

practice.prompt: Supply the full adjectival superlative of calme after la salle: C'est la salle ___ du centre. Meaning the calmest.
practice.explanation: Repeat la before plus calme when it follows the noun.

practice.prompt: Supply the full superlative meaning the least expensive: Ce sont les options ___. Use cher.
practice.explanation: Les and chères agree with feminine plural options.

practice.prompt: Give the comparative of mauvais for a worse situation: La situation est ___ qu'avant. Both taught forms are accepted.
practice.explanation: Pire and agreed plus mauvaise are both possible.

practice.prompt: Use the comparative of mal: Quand je suis fatigué, je conduis ___.
practice.explanation: The comparison concerns performance of an action.

practice.prompt: Supply the fixed phrase better and better for an action: Elle prononce les mots ___.
practice.explanation: An improving action uses mieux.

practice.prompt: Supply plus or moins to express the less I sleep, the more tired I am: Moins je dors, ___ je suis fatigué.
practice.explanation: Less sleep is paired with more fatigue in this intended statement.

practice.prompt: Supply the contracted preposition/article: Les dépenses sont inférieures ___ budget. Use à + le.
practice.explanation: Inférieur takes à; à + le becomes au.

practice.prompt: Supply the adverbial superlative of bien: Parmi nous, c'est elle qui explique ___.
practice.explanation: Le mieux ranks how someone explains and does not agree with elle.

practice.prompt: Supply meilleur in the correct form: Ces nouvelles sont ___ que prévu.
practice.explanation: Feminine plural nouvelles requires meilleures.

practice.prompt: Supply de plus en plus or de moins en moins to mean increasingly reliable: Le service devient ___ fiable.
practice.explanation: The adjective fiable increases in degree.

practice.prompt: Remove the two unnecessary articles: Le plus je lis, le plus je comprends.
answers: Plus je lis, plus je comprends.
practice.explanation: Paired comparative clauses do not take English-style the articles.

practice.prompt: Supply the superlative of mauvais: C'est la ___ solution. Both taught forms are accepted; do not repeat la.
practice.explanation: La pire solution and la plus mauvaise solution are both possible.

practice.prompt: Supply the form of bon meaning best: Ce sont les ___ propositions du concours. Do not repeat les.
practice.explanation: The superlative is les meilleures, with feminine plural agreement and no plus.

practice.prompt: Use the full adverbial superlative of mal: Parmi ces appareils, celui-ci fonctionne ___. Meaning works worst.
practice.explanation: Rank the action with le plus mal, not an agreeing adjective.

practice.prompt: Complete with the adjective pattern for better and better, agreeing with solutions: Ses solutions sont ___. Use de ... en ... and meilleur.
practice.explanation: The improvement concerns feminine plural solutions, so meilleur agrees twice.

practice.prompt: Compare the same proposed arrangement more favourably. Replace bien with its comparative: Pour vous deux, c'est bien de partager les frais. Give only the replacement.
practice.explanation: The starting judgment is c'est bien, so its comparative is c'est mieux, without agreement with vous.

practice.prompt: Your lost documents have been found. Choose the reaction that welcomes the news.
practice.explanation: Tant mieux welcomes a favourable development; tant pis conveys regret or resignation.

practice.prompt: Complete the taught fixed expression, without replacing its first part: Après chaque panne, la situation va de mal en ___.
practice.explanation: De mal en pis is the fixed expression; ordinary action comparisons still use plus mal.

production_task.prompt: Compare two transport options for your team. Include an adjective comparison, an adverb comparison, a superlative, and a plus..., moins... relationship. Base the claims on the situation you invent, not on universal claims about transport.
production_task.model_answer: Pour notre trajet, le train offre une meilleure connexion que le bus. Nous y travaillons mieux parce qu'il y a des tables. C'est l'option la moins fatigante. Plus nous réservons tôt, moins nous payons.
production_task.translation: For our journey, the train offers a better connection than the bus. We work better on it because there are tables. It is the least tiring option. The earlier we book, the less we pay.
rubric: Distinguish meilleur as an adjective from mieux as an adverb.
Use complete paired clauses without adding le.
Make the comparison meaningful in the stated situation.
